# PDF.js defaults packaging and signature-editor enablement are separate changes

The owned patch adds PdfJsDefaultPrefs.js to the installer package and separately sets pdfjs.enableSignatureEditor=true in Thunderbird defaults. It changes neither the PDF.js version nor cryptographic package signing. The public commit title names the editor explicitly, which keeps the feature distinct from the packaging operation. Accepted0b93 retains the packaged defaults and shared PDF.js startup/actor integration, while the explicit comm editor override has been removed. Do not infer the current effective editor preference from that absent override; shared preference contents and load order are outside this source scope. No test or installed-application result is claimed.

Scope: mail/installer.
